brief: The sketch depicts a close-up view of abandoned, complex brass clockwork machinery constructed from corrugated cardboard. Time appears to be slowing down the mechanisms as delicate gears, linkages, and components undergo calcification. Crystals of sediment and mineral deposits slowly form, gradually encapsulating and cementing the intricate workings. The resulting scene is a tableau of decay and petrification, where the metallic and fibrous components are becoming solid, crystalline relics.

statement: This sketch explores the passage of time through a visual metaphor of mechanical decay and petrification. It depicts a close-up view of brass clockwork machinery constructed from corrugated cardboard, where time appears to slow as delicate mechanisms undergo calcification. The scene captures the gradual encapsulation of intricate workings in crystalline formations, creating a tableau of decay and transformation. The viewer observes gears rotating slowly, linkages fading away, and mineral deposits slowly forming around them — all rendered with a translucent sediment background that suggests deep geological time. The piece conveys the quiet, persistent march of time through subtle changes in motion, color, and form, transforming mechanical complexity into fragile, crystalline relics.
